name: Data Augmentation with Virtual Object Insertion
aliases: Virtual Object Insertion for Training Data
definition: An automatic pipeline that inserts diverse 3D car assets into captured images based on estimated lighting to generate training data for 3D object detectors.
summary: Data Augmentation with Virtual Object Insertion automatically generates synthetic training data by inserting 3D assets into real images using differentiable rendering and physics-based lighting estimation, enabling class-agnostic augmentation with realistic shadows and occlusion handling.
